name: doc_probe
description: Say what is inside a document without opening it in the application that made it. OOXML or ZIP: the central directory (member names, sizes, DOS times and flags), every part named *.rels parsed as XML for its relationships and their External targets (user-info, query values and token-shaped text are withheld from the answer, as are token-shaped components of the caller's path and of part names; the whole target goes to a sealed file only with write_values in a job, and the real name behind a withheld part name is kept in a private 0600 file the answer names), members counted when encrypted, corrupt, unsupported or over a budget, and, with extract_to, the members whose NAMES match a code-related pattern, written byte for byte. OLE compound file: byte markers only. RTF: the \objdata and \objclass control words with offsets. PDF: name-token markers with counts and offsets: no page count, no encryption verdict, no resolved action. Decompression is bounded per member, in total and by expansion ratio (only stored and deflated members are read: the standard library cannot bound any other method), the tool has its own time limit, and a bound is reported. Not read: the OLE directory and streams, the PDF object structure, filters and encryption dictionary, the contents of other OOXML parts, macro source or compiled VBA, embedded objects, document protection. Markers and relationships do not show that anything runs or was fetched. A PDF header or an RTF group start away from offset 0 is a second reading of the file only in the form of a real header (`%PDF-1.x`, `{\rtf1`); the same bytes without a version, a ZIP local file header signature that is not at offset 0, and ZIP end-record signatures in the last 64 KiB that form no directory inside the file are a note under `notes`, never partial and never a container; a PDF header after a few bytes is read as a PDF with a note on its offset. A relationship read the clock stopped counts its part under `relationship_parts.not_attempted`, not as failed. An output directory reached through a symbolic link (the directory itself, work/ or the agent's directory under it, or $OUT/tool-output in a job) is refused and nothing is written through it. A stop signal (SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP) ends it with one JSON answer and the exit code 128 plus the signal from the moment the module has run as far as its stop handlers, which are installed at module level and not when main() starts (only the start of the interpreter and the compiling of the file come before); a second signal does nothing while the first is answered, and no hidden temporary file is left. SENSITIVE: write_values writes each value it withheld from the answer (a relationship target, a resource string, a name) whole to a file under $OUT, so the manifest declares secret_output for it and the tool checks SECRET_OUTPUT: in any run that is not a job run as secret output it is refused as JSON before anything is created. extract_to writes byte-for-byte parts of the document the examiner supplied into a directory the examiner names (mode 0600, created exclusively); it is not a value the tool found and is not a flag, so the declaration does not name it. A name, a path, a URL or a message that quotes a credential is withheld with the identifier-shaped strings, from version 12: a value given to a password, token, secret or cookie name (password=..., Pwd=..., a Cookie header), a Name/Value pair in text whose Name is a credential (a number, an array or a long Value too, and the NewValue after an OldValue), a -Password style switch, the argument of ConvertTo-SecureString, curl -u user:pass, mysql -uUSER -pSECRET, a bcrypt hash and the known token families; the text is replaced by a marker that holds only its length. Before, only identifier-shaped strings (tokens, key ids, user-info) were withheld, so these were printed. Known gaps: a pair whose Value is an array nested in another or longer than 4,096 characters, a crypt hash that is not bcrypt, and a secret that has neither a credential name nor a token shape.

path.description: An Office document, PDF, RTF or other ZIP-based package

extract_to.description: Write the members whose names match a code-related pattern here: a directory under work/<your agent id>/ (in a job, under $OUT). Files are created exclusively, mode 0600, and can contain secrets

write_values.description: Write each External target whole to doc-probe-values.jsonl under $OUT (default false; refused outside a job; run the job with secret_output: true)

max_member_bytes.description: Most bytes one member may expand to (default 67108864)

max_total_bytes.description: Most bytes all members may expand to together (default 268435456)

max_members.description: Most members listed and read (default 10000, at most 100000)

max_ratio.description: Most expanded bytes per compressed byte for a member (default 1000)

limit.description: Rows of one table kept in the answer (default 1000, at most 100000); the whole of a longer table is written to a file and named

max_seconds.description: The tool's own time limit in seconds, from 1 to 110 (default 100); a scan that reaches it stops, reports what it read and says so
